officialWindowBaseline.reason: It preserves the official source alpha layers at the official target window; only the final composed portrait can judge seam visibility.

semanticOcclusionCandidate.reason: The manual semantic polygon and target occluder masks define pixel ownership, but only the final native-size composition can judge continuity and expression quality.
semanticOcclusionCandidate.rejectionReason: Native-size review showed that the broad source semantic patch still imported the 03 face scale and removed the correct 02 chin continuity.

targetNativeFeatureCandidate.reason: The 02 native atlas supplies the complete face plate, but the v1 mouth redness threshold also selected a rectangular patch of normal 03 skin.
targetNativeFeatureCandidate.rejectionReason: The 2026-07-25 human screenshot circled a flat, rectangular foreign-skin patch around all three shy mouth frames.

targetNativeFeatureCandidateV2.reason: V2 estimates the local source skin color, rejects connected components touching the mouth ROI boundary, and keeps only components intersecting the mouth-center seed.

eyes: 逐帧以原尺寸检查眼窗四边；两侧头发、额发、肤色和脸部轮廓必须连续，矩形边界不可见
目标 body 原有眼睛、眉毛和睫毛必须完全消失，不得出现双线、残影、雾边或第二套眼位
新眉眼、闭合程度、脸红和汗滴的整体语义必须与 03 官方源表情一致；允许脸红由 02 原生像素承载，但不得因迁移被削弱
连续切换三帧时，眼睛中心、眉线、鼻点和融合范围不得跳动
mouth: 逐帧以原尺寸检查嘴窗四边；下巴、肤色与左右发梢必须连续，矩形边界不可见
目标 body 原有嘴型必须完全消失，不得出现双唇线、重复牙齿、波纹、幽灵线或白雾
新嘴型的中心、宽度、开合和垂直位置必须与 02 目标脸型协调并保留 03 源表情语义
